The pack covers only the CLI, SDKs, the REST API, Terraform, IAM, budgets, free-tier compute VMs and AI release notes, none of which is serverless execution.

rationale: OCI documents a platform-wide CLI that 'provides the same core functionality as the Console,' typical REST APIs across services, and SDKs that ship with documentation. Machine-readable OpenAPI specs were not found at the probed docs-root paths. Missing for 10: evidence of per-service API and CLI reference docs across the whole catalog (not just flagship services), proof the reference format is consistent between services, discoverable OpenAPI/spec artifacts, and independent corroboration of reference completeness.

Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence that budgets and alerts can be configured from account creation, hard caps or automatic enforcement, independent or hands-on corroboration.

rationale: Workload identity federation is a fair question for a cloud provider, so the axis applies.
